name: Marie Lambeau
text:
[reaction] After damage is placed on Marie Lambeau: Draw 2 cards and discard 1 of them. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. If you succeed, heal 1 damage.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Grand-Mère's Charm, Called to Guinée, 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "I've got one hell of a showstopper in store for you tonight."

name: Grand-Mère's Charm
text:
Marie Lambeau deck only.
[fast] Take 1 direct damage and exhaust Grand-Mère's Charm: Replenish 1 charge on an asset at your location.

name: Called to Guinée
text: Revelation - Put Called to Guinée into play in your threat area. You cannot heal damage. [action] Choose and discard 3 cards from your hand: Discard Called to Guinée.

name: Hemophobia
text: Revelation - Put Hemophobia into play in your threat area. Forced - The first time each round an investigator at your location takes damage: Take 1 horror. [action][action]: Discard Hemophobia.

name: Offering Bowl
text:
Uses (3 offerings). If there are no offerings on Offering Bowl, discard it.
[fast] Spend 1 offering and exhaust Offering Bowl: Take 1 damage and gain 2 resources.
flavor: Everything has its price, but how it is paid is up for negotiation.

name: Bloodstone
text: You get +1 [willpower].
flavor: A symbol for vitality and courage in ancient times, wearing the heliotrope has you wondering if there wasn't some measure of truth to the old stories.

name: Sacrificial Doll
text:
While you have 3 or fewer remaining health, Sacrificial Doll does not take up a hand slot.
[reaction] After you reveal a non-[auto_fail] chaos token during a skill test, take 1 damage and exhaust Sacrificial Doll: Cancel that token and reveal tokens from the chaos bag until a symbol token is revealed. Resolve that token and ignore the rest.

name: Shadowmeld
text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Evade ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to move to a connecting location. If you reveal a [tablet] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Shadowmeld (if you cannot, lose 1 action and discard this card).

name: Consume Life
text: Fight ([willpower]). This attack deals +1 damage. If this attack defeats an enemy, heal 1 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
flavor: True power is in the blood.

name: Favor of Baalshandor
text:
As an additional cost to play Favor of Baalshandor, take 1 damage.
Play a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 3. Playing this card does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Infuse Life
text: Heal 3 damage from among investigators and/or [[Ally]] assets at your location.

name: Mirror Form
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose a [[Spell]] or [[Charm]] asset in your hand and put it into play under your control. When the round ends, shuffle that asset into your deck if it is still in play.

name: Spiritual Charm
text: Parley. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location or at a connecting location. Move that enemy to your location, engage it, and gain resources equal to its combined damage/horror values.

name: Blood Curse
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this skill test is successful, take 1 direct damage.
flavor: What wouldn't you give for a taste of true power?

name: Cosmic Guidance
text: If this skill test is successful, heal 1 damage from the performing investigator.
flavor: "From time to time people... [shuddered] at the small dark speck that paraded by day and the glimmering will-o'-the-wisp that danced by night." - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Mound"

name: Ceremonial Robes
text: Reduce the cost of the first [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card you play each round by 1.
flavor: "They worshipped, so they said, the Great Old Ones who lived ages before there were any men, and who came to the young world out of the sky." -H. P. Lovecraft, The Call of Cthulhu

name: Eldritch Whispers
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If a symbol token is revealed during this test, place up to 2 charges or 2 secrets among assets you control.

name: Blood Ward
text:
Fast. Play when a non-[[Elite]] enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack and heal 2 damage from the targeted investigator.

name: Retribution
text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
You take all damage and horror from this attack. For each point of damage/horror taken, deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.

name: Dread Curse of Azathoth
text: Exceptional. [action] Place 1 doom on Dread Curse of Azathoth: Fight ([willpower]). You get +2 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If this attack defeats an enemy, remove 1 doom from Dread Curse of Azathoth. If a [skull] or [elder_thing] token is revealed during this test, remove all doom from this card.

name: Ritual Dagger
text: [action]: Fight ([combat]). Add your [willpower] to your [combat] for this attack. [reaction] After you play a [[Spell]] event, take 1 damage and exhaust Ritual Dagger: Shuffle that event into your deck instead of discarding it.

name: Spiritual Intuition
text: Starting. (You may begin the game with 1 copy of a starting card in your opening hand.) [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test (+2 [willpower] instead if this test is on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card). [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test (+2 [combat] instead if this test is on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card).

name: Blood Curse
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, deal 1 damage to a card with health at your location.
flavor: What wouldn't you give for a taste of true power?

name: Arcane Experience
text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck.
You have 1 additional arcane slot.
flavor: "The hidden cults to which these witches belonged often guarded and handed down surprising secrets from elder, forgotten aeons." -H. P. Lovecraft, "Dreams in the Witch House"

name: Jim Culver
text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] After you take damage and/or horror, exhaust Jim Culver: Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
flavor: "You see these folks too? You never really get used to them."

name: Ultimate Sacrifice
text:
Fast. Play when the investigation phase ends.
Repeat the investigation phase. At the end of that phase, you are defeated and suffer 1 physical trauma. Max once per game.

name: Second Sight
text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Investigate ([willpower]). You get +2 [willpower] for this investigation. If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to discover 1 additional clue at your location or 1 clue at a connecting location. If you reveal a [cultist] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Second Sight (if you cannot, take 1 horror and discard this card).

name: Shadowmeld
text: Uses (5 charges). [action]: Evade ([willpower]). You get +2 [willpower] for this evasion. If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to move to a location up to 2 connections away. If you reveal a [tablet] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Shadowmeld (if you cannot, lose 1 action and discard this card).

name: Bend Blood
text: Fight ([willpower]). You get +3 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to each other enemy at your location. Each enemy dealt damage by Bend Blood cannot attack you for the remainder of the round.
